paite: Huan Israel suante'n Mizpah khua ah, i lak ua mi kuamah in i tanute uh Benjamin suante zi ding in i pe kei ding uh, chi in akichiam uhi.
heading: Benjaminte Zi Ding
english: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpah, saying, “None of us will give his daughter to Benjamin as a wife.”

paite: Bethel ah mipite ahoh ua, Pathian ma ah nitak tan in atu ua, a-awte uh suah in akap vongvong uhi.
english: The people came to Bethel and sat there until evening before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept severely.

paite: Amau bel, "Aw TOUPA Israelte' Pathian, bangchidan ahia Israelte lak a hichibang thil ahong om?" achi uhi.
english: They said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, why has this happened in Israel, that there should be one tribe lacking in Israel today?”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, azing in zingkhang in athou ua, huai ah maitam abawl ua, halmang thillatte leh lemna thillatte alan uhi.
english: On the next day, the people rose early and built an altar there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.

paite: Israel suante'n, Israel nam tengteng lak a TOUPA kiang a paikhawm pawl lak a va tel tei lou kuate ahi ua? achi uh. Mizpah a TOUPA kiang ava hoh lou peuhmahte bel, thah ngeingei ding ahi, chi in ana kichiamta uhi.
english: The children of Israel said, “Who is there among all the tribes of Israel who didn’t come up in the assembly to Yahweh?” For they had made a great oath concerning him who didn’t come up to Yahweh to Mizpah, saying, “He shall surely be put to death.”

paite: Israel suante a-unaupa uh Benjamin suante tungthu ah akisik ua, "Tuni in Israel suante lak ah nam khat satkhiak ahita, achi uhi.
english: The children of Israel grieved for Benjamin their brother, and said, “There is one tribe cut off from Israel today.

paite: A-omsunte a ding in azi ding uh bangchi in i hihta ding ua? I tanute uh lah azi ding ua neisak lou ding in TOUPA min lou in i na kichiamta ngal ua,” achi uhi.
english: How shall we provide wives for those who remain, since we have sworn by Yahweh that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?”

paite: Amau achi ua, Mizpah a TOUPA kiang a hong paitou lou Israel namte lak ah a-om hia? Ngai in, kikhawm pawl omna mun ah Jabesh-gilead mite lak ah khat lel leng ahong hoh kei uhi.
english: They said, “What one is there of the tribes of Israel who didn’t come up to Yahweh to Mizpah?” Behold, no one came from Jabesh Gilead to the camp to the assembly.

paite: Mite akisim uleh, ngai in, Jabesh-gilead gam a omte khat lel leng ana omta kei uhi.
english: For when the people were counted, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead there.

paite: Omkhawmte'n mihangsan hoih ngen singkhat-le-sangnih asawl uhi. "Kuan unla, Jabesh-gilead gam a omte numei leh atanu neute uh toh namsau in va satlum vek un.
english: The congregation sent twelve thousand of the most valiant men there, and commanded them, saying, “Go and strike the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the little ones.

paite: Na hihdan ding uh hichibang ahi. Mi tengteng leh numei, pasal kithuahpih khinsa peuhmah hihmangthang vek un,” chi in thu apia uhi.
english: This is the thing that you shall do: you shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman who has lain with a man.”

paite: Jabesh-gilead gam a omte lak ah nungak zali, pasal kithuahpih ngei het louh amu uhi. Huchi in a-omna uh Shiloh ah api ua, huai tuh Kanaan gam a om ahi.
english: They found among the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead four hundred young virgins who had not known man by lying with him; and they brought them to the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.

paite: Omkhawm tengteng in mi asawl ua, Rimmon suangpi a om Benjamin suante ava houpih ua, kilemna bawl ding in asam uhi.
english: The whole congregation sent and spoke to the children of Benjamin who were in the rock of Rimmon, and proclaimed peace to them.

paite: Huaitak in Benjamin pawl ahong nawn ua; Jabesh-gilead gam a numei ahawite uh azi ding un apia uhi. Huchi in leng akiching kei lai uhi.
english: Benjamin returned at that time; and they gave them the women whom they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh Gilead. There still weren’t enough for them.

paite: Israel nam lak a TOUPA'N kihih- tuamna ana bawl ziak in mite, Benjamin suante tungthu ah akisik uhi.
english: The people grieved for Benjamin, because Yahweh had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.

paite: Huchi in omkhawmte upate'n, "Adamlaite zi ding bang i chih ding ua? Benjamin suante lak a numeite lah hihmang ahita ngal ua?" achi uhi.
english: Then the elders of the congregation said, “How shall we provide wives for those who remain, since the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?”

paite: "Amau Israel nam hihmanlouhna ding in Benjamin suan omsunte bangchi in suan i neisak ding ua?
english: They said, “There must be an inheritance for those who are escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe not be blotted out from Israel.

paite: I tanute uh lah azi un i neisak thei ngal kei ua," achi uhi. Israel suante'n, "Kuapeuh Benjamin suante zi dia neisak peuhmah hamsiat in om uhen," chi in akichiam uhi.
english: However, we may not give them wives of our daughters, for the children of Israel had sworn, saying, ‘Cursed is he who gives a wife to Benjamin.’”

paite: Amau, "Ngai un, Bethel mallam, Bethel a pan Shekem zotna lamlian suahlam pang a Lebonah simlam a om Shiloh ah kum sim in TOUPA a ding in ankuangluina a-om,” achi uhi.
english: They said, “Behold, there is a feast of Yahweh from year to year in Shiloh, which is on the north of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.”

paite: Amau Benjamin suante kiang ah, "Va hoh unla, grep mun ah va guktan un;
english: They commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, “Go and lie in wait in the vineyards,

paite: Na en unla, ngai un, Shiloh a nungakte lamna a lam dia ahong pawt uleh, grep mun a pan hong pawt unla, Shiloh nungakte na zi ding un man chiat unla, Benjaminte gam ah paipih un.
english: and see, and behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in the dances, then come out of the vineyards, and each man catch his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, apate uh hiam, asanggampate uh hiam kalh dia i kiang ua ahong uleh, akiang uah, hon hehpih un. Kidouna sung in lah zi ka guan thei kei uh. Nou lah na tanute uh na piak thoh un hilou a, kichiamna a moh tang lou ding na hi uh," ka chi ding uh, achi uhi.
english: It shall be, when their fathers or their brothers come to complain to us, that we will say to them, ‘Grant them graciously to us, because we didn’t take for each man his wife in battle, neither did you give them to them; otherwise you would now be guilty.’”

paite: Benjamin suante'n huchibang in ahih uhi. Lampawlte lak a mi amau zah chiat zi ding in aman ua, apaimangpihta uhi. Huchi in agam uah apai ua, khopite apuah nawn ua, huai ah atengta uhi.
english: The children of Benjamin did so, and took wives for themselves according to their number, of those who danced, whom they carried off. They went and returned to their inheritance, built the cities, and lived in them.

paite: Huaitak in huai a pan Israel suante bel amau chichi leh amau namnam in akihuituam nawn ua, huai nungsiah amau gam chiat ah apai nawn uhi.
english: The children of Israel departed from there at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they each went out from there to his own inheritance.

paite: Huai lai in Israelte lak ah kumpipa a-om kei a; michih in ama mitmuh a dik asak bang in ahih chiat uhi.
english: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.
